b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Pest, 15 March 1848
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks what the young people did in Pest on 15 March 1848.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.prompt: Tell the examiner where the young people met and what they printed.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.target: A fiatalok a Pilvax kávéházban gyűltek össze. Kinyomtatták a tizenkét pontot.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.english: The young people met in the Pilvax Café. They printed the Twelve Points.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-01.canDo: I can say what March 15 commemorates and what happened in Pest in 1848.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Saint Stephen's Day
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.scenario: On a school visit in Budapest the teacher asks you, a visitor preparing for citizenship, what people celebrate on 20 August.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.prompt: Tell the teacher what the holiday is for and what people watch in the evening.
cues: Say what people watch in the evening
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.target: Augusztus 20-án az államalapítást ünnepeljük. Este tűzijátékot néznek a Duna felett.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.english: On August 20 we celebrate the founding of the state. In the evening they watch fireworks over the Danube.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-02.canDo: I can say what August 20 commemorates and how people celebrate it.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Republic of 1989
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks what happened on 23 October 1989.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.prompt: Tell the examiner who proclaimed the Republic and from where.
cues: Say from where he did it
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.target: Szűrös Mátyás kikiáltotta a Magyar Köztársaságot a Parlament erkélyéről.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.english: Mátyás Szűrös proclaimed the Republic of Hungary from the balcony of the Parliament.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-03.canDo: I can say what happened on 23 October 1956 and on 23 October 1989.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Martyrs of Arad
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.scenario: In a museum in Budapest the guide asks you what the nation remembers on 6 October.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.prompt: Tell the guide whom the nation remembers on October 6 and in which year they were executed.
cues: Say in which year they were executed
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.target: Október 6-án az aradi vértanúkra emlékezünk. Őket 1849-ben végezték ki.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.english: On October 6 we remember the martyrs of Arad. They were executed in 1849.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-04.canDo: I can say whom the nation remembers on October 6 and what June 4 is the day of.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day of Remembrance
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.scenario: At the House of Terror Museum a teacher asks you what is remembered on 16 April.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.prompt: Tell the teacher what April 16 is the memorial day of and what began on that day in 1944.
cues: Say what the memorial day is for
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.target: Április 16-a a holokauszt magyarországi áldozatainak emléknapja. 1944-ben ezen a napon kezdődött a gettósítás.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.english: April 16 is the memorial day of the Hungarian victims of the Holocaust. In 1944 the ghettoisation began on this day.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-05.canDo: I can say what February 25 and April 16 commemorate.

b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Three National Holidays
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks you to name the national holidays of Hungary.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.target: A három nemzeti ünnep március 15., augusztus 20. és október 23.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.english: The three national holidays are March 15, August 20 and October 23.
b1-nemzetiunnepek-consolidation.canDo: I can name the three national holidays and say what each commemorates.
